definition: a person who owns over a million
description: In the gravel courtyard of a large stone villa among vineyard hills, a man with slicked-back hair, an open cream silk shirt, gold chains, black trousers and loafers strides across a white towel laid over a puddle and keeps walking towards the viewer. Four young women in white blouses and black trousers follow him in a line, carrying expensive leather handbags, one holding a small dachshund in a bag. Classic silver sports cars are parked by a stone fountain, and tall cypress trees stand by the courtyard.

taps.phrase: to lead a line of women

de.answer: Er führt eine Reihe von Frauen an.
de.question: Was macht der Millionär?

es.answer: Está encabezando una fila de mujeres.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el millonario?

fr.answer: Il mène une file de femmes.
fr.question: Que fait le millionnaire ?
